name: OSPD Activity Types Register
abstract:
The activity types of the OGC Open Science Persistent Demonstrator (OSPD), under stable
`https://w3id.org/ogc/ospd/activity-type/` URIs: the generic activity types, grouped into families.
description:
The activity types of OSPD and the model they are described with: the activity type, geoprocessing and
machine learning profiles of the Registered Item Model (`profiles/`), the catalogs (`core/`) and the generic
activity types, one block and one concept scheme per family (`generic/<family>`). Specific types are defined
by the participant registers, loaded from their ogcincubator forks, and point to a generic type with
`skos:broader`. This register supersedes the [Activity Type Register](https://ogcincubator.github.io/activity-type-register/).

bblocks.name: Activity Types Register Profile
bblocks.title: Model of activity types, profiled from the Registered Item Model
bblocks.abstract: A profile of the Registered Item Model for governed activity type records in the acttype:ActivityType hierarchy, with related PROV object types and an optional plan.
bblocks.description: An activity type register governs activity types with identifiers, statuses and change history. Specific activity type classes specialise acttype:ActivityType, a sub-class of rim:RegisterItem. Registered types may be classes used to type individual activity records; those records also inherit register item requirements. Every activity type record uses acttype:activityTypeItemClass and belongs to the acttype:ActivityType hierarchy through rdf:type. Related entity, agent and activity types and an optional prov:Plan describe the expected activity. Further profiles specialise the root and constrain these related types.

bblocks.name: OSPD Activity Types Register
bblocks.abstract: The catalogs of the OSPD activity types: the OSPD catalog and, in it, the catalog of the generic activity types, one concept scheme per family. Participant registers specialise the generic types.

resources.title: OSPD activity types catalogs

bblocks.name: Geoprocessing Activity Types Profile
bblocks.title: Registers of geoprocessing activity types, profiled from the Activity Type Register Profile
bblocks.abstract: A profile of the Activity Type Register Profile for geoprocessing activity types: registered sub-classes of geoproc:GeoprocessingActivityType, each required to use or generate at least one GeoSPARQL spatial data type.
bblocks.description: Geoprocessing activities (reprojection, clipping, index computation, classification, model inference over imagery) are distinguished from other activities by the kind of data they use and produce. This block adds geoproc:GeoprocessingActivityType, a sub-class of acttype:ActivityType that every registered geoprocessing activity type specialises. It also constrains the related PROV object types such a type declares: at least one acttype:usedEntityType or acttype:generatedEntityType must be a GeoSPARQL 1.1 spatial type (geo:SpatialObject or geo:SpatialObjectCollection, or a sub-class of either). Further profiles, such as the ML Activity Types Profile, specialise geoproc:GeoprocessingActivityType in turn and add their own constraints.

bblocks.name: SpatioTemporal ML Activity Types Profile
bblocks.title: SpatioTemporal Machine learning training/inference activities, profiled from the Registered Item Model
bblocks.abstract: A profile of the SpatioTemporal Machine learning Activity Types Profile describing spatiotemporal machine learning training and inference runs, and registrable ML activity types, using the STAC MLM extension's task, framework/accelerator and input/output vocabulary.
bblocks.description: The STAC Machine Learning Model (MLM) extension describes a model as a static artifact — a STAC Item or Collection with declared inputs, outputs and requirements — but has no notion of a particular run of that model. This block adds that: mlact:MLActivityType (with mlact:TrainingActivityType and mlact:InferenceActivityType sub-types) is a geoproc:GeoprocessingActivityType recording one execution, and so can be specialised into ML activity types held in an activity type register. It is also a rim:RegisterAction. In this ecosystem, running a model is itself a governed act — typically the one that adds a derived product to a register as a new rim:RegisterItem — so the run belongs in the same audit trail as any other register action. The activity's task, framework and accelerator are drawn from the MLM extension's own SKOS schemes rather than redefined, and its recorded inputs/outputs (mlact:ActivityInput / mlact:ActivityOutput, both prov:Entity) each declare via dct:conformsTo which of the model's own declared mlm:ModelInput/mlm:ModelOutput specifications they realise. Registered ML activity types must declare at least one mlact:ActivityInput sub-type as a used entity type, and registered inference types at least one mlact:ActivityOutput sub-type as a generated entity type.
